{{Quote|Is there any way my men and I can get out of this alive, Captain Calrissian? I won't give you those hull-scrapings about 'just following orders' again&mdash;only, well, I'm not too fond of the idea of dying, just now.|Myle Jandler, to Lando Calrissian|<ref name="sharu" />}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Myle Jandler''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] [[Police officer/Legends|officer]] who worked as a [[Constable/Legends|Constable]] under colonial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Duttes Mer]] in the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. A hulking, powerful man, Jandler was formerly the owner of the [[Spaceman's Rest]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Rafa IV]], before losing the bar [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]]. Jandler then settled in as one of Mer's chief thugs, and was assigned to keep tabs on [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] after Mer hired him to acquire the ancient [[Mindharp of Sharu/Legends|Mindharp]] of [[Sharu/Legends|Sharu]] in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]. Later, Jandler became Chief Supervisor of the penal colony on [[Rafa V]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Well I suppose this is farewell, then, old bluecoat. I trust you and your comrades will enjoy the trip."<br />"It beats a beam in the eye from a hot laser, Captain Calrissian&mdash;"<br />"Call me Lando, no one else seems to be able to do it."<br />"Lando, then. And when we get there, none of us will be in any particular hurry to report it, ''will we, guys?''<nowiki></nowiki>|Lando Calrissian and Myle Jandler part ways on Rafa V|<ref name="sharu" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rafa IV]], Myle Jandler at one point owned the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] known as the [[Spaceman's Rest]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Teguta Lusat]], before he lost the bar in a table game. The winner of Spaceman's Rest placed the day-to-day operations into the trust of a [[Bartender droid/Legends|bartender droid]]&mdash;a development that rankled the [[Anti-droid sentiment/Legends|droid-hating]] Jandler, who at one point attempted to insert a clause into the transfer agreement that would ensure droid would never be allowed on the premises. By [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], Jandler was banned from the premises of the Spaceman's Rest. Instead, Jandler focused on working as a [[Constable/Legends|Constable]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] under colonial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Duttes Mer]], who utilized Jandler's intimidating size as one of his chief hatchet men.<ref name="sharu" />

In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], Jandler's employer dispatched him to apprehend [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], an offworld [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] whom Mer and associate [[Rokur Gepta]] identified as a promising candidate to recover the [[Mindharp of Sharu/Legends|Mindharp]], an extremely valuable [[Sharu/Legends|Sharu]] artifact located amidst the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system's]] sprawling ruins. Jandler and another constable accomplished this by breaking into Calrissian's hotel room, physically seizing him and beating him bloody, before depositing him in Mer's office. That wouldn't be Jandler's last encounter with the smuggler&mdash;not long after, Jandler barged into Spaceman's Rest in order to confront Calrissian, after hearing that the man had entered his former establishment accompanied by a [[Vuffi Raa|droid]] and a [[Mohs|Toka]]. Jandler pulled a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on the party before attacking the bartender droid, but a distraction from Calrissian allowed the droid to knock Jandler unconscious with a chair and remove him from the premises.<ref name="sharu" />

Jandler and Calrissian would cross paths again one final time soon afterward. Having dispatched him to [[Rafa V]] to find the Mindharp, Mer had lost his trust in the smuggler, and dispatched Jandler and a squad of constables to arrest him and retrieve the artifact. Jandler and his men tracked Calrissian down, but were swiftly defeated. Fed up with Mer sending him on missions with little information&mdash;and discovering a surprising rapport with Calrissian&mdash;Jandler and the smuggler agreed to allow each other to go their separate ways peacefully, with Jandler and his men promptly departing Rafa V in their own [[cargo barge]]. Jandler and the other constables were safely recovered from [[Rafa XI]] not long afterward, and placed under house arrest by Mer.<ref name="sharu" />

Jandler later took the role of Chief Supervisor of the penal colony on Rafa V after the activation of the Mindharp and the subsequent restoration of Sharu civilization, in charge of [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] such as the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Corask Slen'da]], an [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] arrested for interfering with Sharu-[[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] relations by [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] key Centrality-friendly Sharu. When a group of offworld adventurers arrived on Rafa V to retrieve Slen'da, Jandler let them leave with the Bothan, as the prisoner's mental capacity appeared to have been withered to nothing from exposure to Rafa V's [[life-crystal]]s.<ref name="gamer5">{{GamerCite|5|A Campaign Guide to the Centrality}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Oh yeah&mdash;you there! Yeah, I'm talkin' to you! It's just like Bernie down to the Pyramid told me! And not only with a snivelin', job-stealin' droid at the table, but a dirty Toka, too! What are you sailor, some kind of pervert?|Myle Jandler, to Lando Calrissian|<ref name="sharu" />}}
A hulking man standing around two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and weighing around 85 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], Myle Jandler was violent to match, hating droids and the Rafa system's native [[Toka]] with a passion. Nevertheless, Jandler grew on Lando Calrissian, who admired the neat and clean-shaven man's sense of style. Although he was one of Duttes Mer's most trusted thugs, Jandler detested the man, realizing that the governor cared nothing for the men who worked for him. Jandler prioritized his own well-being ahead of his employer, and was willing to abandon his mission in order to secure his own safety.<ref name="sharu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Myle Jandler appeared in ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]'', a novel written by [[L. Neil Smith]] and released in [[1983]].<ref name="sharu" />
